# Weekly program

The recurring plan of the contest: the week board, a show editor, the seats that lead to the final, checks, and the review before a save.

[QuotaMeter](#quotameter) · [ProgramBoard](#programboard) · [SlotEditor](#sloteditor) · [QualificationFlow](#qualificationflow) · [ProgramChecks](#programchecks) · [ProgramImpact](#programimpact) · [UpcomingShows](#upcomingshows)

### QuotaMeter

How full a show is: a bar and the numbers. Plain below 80%, "Filling" and amber from 80%, "Full" and red at 100%.

```ts
import { QuotaMeter } from '@/contest/components/QuotaMeter'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `number` |  | People who registered. |
| `quota` *(required)* | `number` |  | Places there are. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | The size of the bar. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<QuotaMeter value={864} quota={1000} />
```

- A `role="meter"` with a text value such as "864 of 1,000 places taken, filling". The words carry the state, so colour is never the only cue.

### ProgramBoard

The week at a glance: seven day columns, Monday first, each with its shows. A show card has the start time, the topic, the final seats it gives (or "Final") and how full it is. Today is marked, shows on air or about to start say so, and the final is drawn apart from the daily shows.

```ts
import { ProgramBoard } from '@/contest/components/ProgramBoard'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `program` *(required)* | `WeeklyProgram` |  | The program. |
| `registrations` *(required)* | `Record<string, number>` |  | How many people registered, by occurrence key (`slotId@YYYY-MM-DD`). See `useRegistrations`. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. The week shown is the one that holds this moment. |
| `selectedId` | `string` |  | The slot being edited. |
| `onSelect` | `(slot: ProgramSlot) => void` |  | Makes each show a button. |
| `onAdd` | `(weekday: Weekday) => void` |  | Shows an "Add" button on days that have no show. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ProgramBoard program={program} registrations={registrations} now={now} selectedId={id} onSelect={(s) => setId(s.id)} onAdd={addShow} />
```

- Without `onSelect` it is read-only: the version for players. The columns follow the width of the board, not of the screen: seven, four, two, then one.
- A show that is over shows "Done" and no meter.

### SlotEditor

One show of the program as a short form: daily or final, the day, the start time and length, the topic, the quota (with presets) and, for a daily show, how many of its best players win a seat in the final.

```ts
import { SlotEditor } from '@/contest/components/SlotEditor'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` *(required)* | `ProgramSlot` |  | The show being edited. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(slot: ProgramSlot) => void` |  | Called with the whole updated slot. |
| `topics` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | The topics to choose from. |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  | Shows a "Remove this show" button. |
| `registered` | `number` | `0` | People registered for the coming shows of this slot. A warning appears when there are some. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SlotEditor slot={slot} topics={topics} registered={registered} onChange={patch} onRemove={() => remove(slot.id)} />
```

- Making a show a final sets its seats to 0; the final gives none.

### QualificationFlow

How the week leads to the final: one bar with a segment for every daily show, as wide as the seats it gives, against the room the final has. Seats that are left stay open; seats above the room are marked as too many.

```ts
import { QualificationFlow } from '@/contest/components/QualificationFlow'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `program` *(required)* | `WeeklyProgram` |  | The program. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<QualificationFlow program={draft} />
```

- The bar has a text alternative and a list under it, so the seats of each day can be read without the colours.

### ProgramChecks

What is wrong with the program, errors first: overlapping shows, too many seats for the final, a missing topic or quota, a final in the middle of the week, a topic three days in a row, a start in the night.

```ts
import { ProgramChecks } from '@/contest/components/ProgramChecks'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `program` *(required)* | `WeeklyProgram` |  | The program to check. |
| `onSelect` | `(slotId: Id) => void` |  | Makes each check a button that jumps to the show it is about. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ProgramChecks program={draft} onSelect={setSelectedId} />
```

- The checks come from `programChecks`. The adapter refuses to save a program with an error, so the checks and the server say the same thing.

### ProgramImpact

The review before a save: every changed show with what the change does to the people who registered. A show on air is locked, a show with registrations needs a tick in the confirm box, anything else is safe. Errors in the program stop the save too. Nothing shows while the two programs are the same.

```ts
import { ProgramImpact } from '@/contest/components/ProgramImpact'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prev` *(required)* | `WeeklyProgram` |  | The saved program. |
| `next` *(required)* | `WeeklyProgram` |  | The program with the edits. |
| `registrations` *(required)* | `Record<string, number>` |  | How many people registered, by occurrence key. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. A show that has started is locked. |
| `onSave` *(required)* | `(confirmed: boolean) => void` |  | Called with `true` when the editor ticked the confirm box for a change that touches registered people. |
| `onDiscard` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the edits are thrown away. |
| `saving` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner on the save button. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ProgramImpact prev={saved} next={draft} registrations={registrations} now={now} onSave={(confirmed) => save(draft, { confirmed })} onDiscard={() => setDraft(null)} />
```

- The rules are in `impactOf`: a started show is `blocked`, a show with registrations is `confirm`, the rest is `free`. The in-memory adapter applies the same rules when `saveProgram` is called.

### UpcomingShows

The next shows in time order. The first one has a live countdown; each row has the day, the start time, the topic, how full it is and, when `lineup` says so, whether its questions are ready.

```ts
import { UpcomingShows } from '@/contest/components/UpcomingShows'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `program` *(required)* | `WeeklyProgram` |  | The program. |
| `registrations` *(required)* | `Record<string, number>` |  | How many people registered, by occurrence key. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `limit` | `number` | `5` | How many shows to list. |
| `lineup` | `(occurrence: Occurrence) => { label: string; tone?: Tone } \| undefined` |  | Says what is ready for a show, for example `{ label: 'Line-up ready', tone: 'success' }`. |
| `onOpen` | `(occurrence: Occurrence) => void` |  | Makes each row a button. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<UpcomingShows program={program} registrations={registrations} now={now} lineup={(o) => hasLineup(o.date) ? { label: 'Line-up ready', tone: 'success' } : { label: 'No line-up', tone: 'warning' }} />
```
